#!/bin/bash

echo "Installing Speech to Text App for Linux (Arch Linux)"

# Check if running as root
if [ "$EUID" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Please don't run as root. Use sudo for pacman commands only."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing system dependencies..."
sudo pacman -Syu --noconfirm
sudo pacman -S --noconfirm python python-pip python-gobject gtk3 portaudio

echo "Installing Python dependencies..."
pip install --user -r requirements.txt

echo "Setting up environment file..."
if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    cp .env.example .env
    echo "Created .env file. Please edit it with your OpenAI API key if you want to use API mode."
fi

echo "Making main.py executable..."
chmod +x main.py

echo "Installation complete!"
echo "Run './main.py' to start the application."
echo ""
echo "Note: For offline mode, models will be downloaded automatically when first used."
echo "For API mode, edit the .env file with your OpenAI API key."
